company.description: Thiqa Tutoring (TT) is Tutors Providers, by customers, for educational and teaching services. International educational and teaching methodologies and standards. Thiqa Education is an education platform focused on delivering structured learning programs, training courses, and academic support services. It aims to enhance student knowledge and skills through accessible learning resources, guided instruction, and practical development opportunities. The platform supports learners across different levels, helping them achieve academic success and build stronger foundations for future educational and career growth.
